skyrecipes.midnightconfig.title: SkyRecipes Settings
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorEnab: Evaluate math in the RRV search bar. Smart mode recognizes obvious calculations without requiring an = prefix.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorInpu: Smart recognizes obvious calculations automatically. Choose Explicit Only if you want every calculation to begin with =.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorDisp: Inside Search Bar keeps feedback compact. Expanded Panel shows results, errors, and help above the search bar.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorPrec: Maximum decimal places shown in calculator results. This does not change calculation accuracy.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorResu: Automatic shows the clearest result that fits. Full Number uses digits and separators. Compact uses familiar k, m, b, and t suffixes.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorHist: Number of calculations kept for Up/Down history during this game session.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorCont: Show useful function and ans completions in gray. Press Tab or Right Arrow to accept one.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.calculatorEsca: Close the current menu when Escape is pressed during a calculation. Disable to leave calculator mode and restore the previous item search instead.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.familyExpansio: Recipe shows the selected tier and the family steps leading to it. Usage puts the next family upgrade first.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.groupTieredIte: Collapse tiered SkyBlock items (minion tiers, pet rarities, enchantment levels, accessory upgrades, ...) into expandable stacks in the item list. Individual groups can be managed in RRV's Stack Groups screen.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.groupCraftedCh: Also group items that craft directly into one another: compaction lines (Diamond → Enchanted Diamond → Enchanted Diamond Block), weapon upgrade lines (Aspect of the End → Aspect of the Void), and similar. Takes effect after the next data load (usually a game restart).
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.shardFusionRec: Show fusion recipes for attribute shards (data from skyshards.com). Takes effect after the next data load (usually a game restart).
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.hideCategoryBu: Completely hides the compact category icon row above the RRV search bar.
Hide Category Buttons When Not Searching
Hides category buttons when RRV is set to 'Only visible when searching' and the search bar is empty.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.hideEmptyBookm: Auto-hides the bookmark side-panel when no bookmarks exist.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.craftablesCoun: When the side panel is set to Craftables, only show SkyBlock items whose full ingredient amounts are in your inventory. Disable to list an item as craftable when you have at least one of each ingredient, like RRV does for vanilla recipes.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.wideRrvSearchB: Expands the RRV search bar. In centred mode it widens up to the configured width but never shrinks below RRV's default. In item-list mode it is limited by the available item-list space.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.blockKeybindsW: Stops other mods' inventory keybinds from firing while you are typing in an RRV search box. Escape and Tab still work as normal.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.rememberSearch: Keep the last item search or active calculation when menus are closed. When disabled, the next menu opens with a blank search bar.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.rrvSearchBarWi: Minimum width for the search bar when wide mode is enabled.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.rrvItemListWid: Shrinks the RRV item-list overlay width as a percentage.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.rrvSidePanelWi: Shrinks the RRV side-panel overlay width as a percentage.
skyrecipes.midnightconfig.dataRefreshInt: How often to check for updated NEU repository data (in minutes).
